The implementation proposal gate must invoke these commands and prove their
behavioral test counts and receipt digests. It may not scan for test names or
fixture strings. A successful command that executes zero selected tests fails
the gate.

## Migration and Compatibility

0. Install Phase -2 foundation from approved HEAD under the existing protected-
   branch checks, OIDC merge evidence and two-reviewer quorum. Exact-set the
   minimal gateway/coordinator/store/root-and-purpose-key/anchor/sentinel diff,
   persist the recoverable install journal before every external action, and
   have a distinct attestor reobserve the installed foundation. Commit only the
   fixed revision-one `foundation_sentinel` gate pointer. A crash, quorum drift,
   wrong installer/attestor identity or third state converges to the same
   foundation lineage or `reconciliation_required`; it creates no Phase -1 or
   implementation work.
1. Execute Phase -1 as an independently reviewed protected-base precursor on
   that current foundation. Exact-set its controller/policy/test/required-check
   diff under the existing repository gates, bind the typed Phase -1 review
   receipt, and have the distinct read-only collector attest protected HEAD,
   required-check ruleset, signed controller build/designated requirement and
   Phase 0 change-policy digest. Make that
   `AgentContextPhaseMinusOneAttestationV1` a required check and verify its live
   protected-branch readback. Then journal and commit the first pointer CAS from
   the exact foundation sentinel to the bootstrap manifest before bootstrap
   execution; after its receipt, journal and commit the second CAS from the
   bootstrap manifest to the full manifest. Wrong/missing/stale controller,
   policy, collector, review receipt, pointer, ruleset or HEAD produces zero
   implementation work.
2. Inventory production prompts, `skill_role`, inline skills, external bundles,
   hardcoded role maps, existing snapshot representations, active legacy runs,
   all execution/side-effect producers, and duplicate sources without changing
   runtime behavior. Refresh the affected baseline from
   `docs/reference/current-system-baseline.md` and retain the routed review pack
   beside the implementation proposal.
3. Publish normative JSON Schemas/vectors and add Rust and Swift readers for
   legacy pre-P066, P066, and `agent_context_envelope_v2`. Keep production
   writes on the old path until every discriminator/error parity gate passes.
4. Expand the minimal Phase -2 authority foundation into the complete production
   authority component/key matrix, then add genesis/base-ledger serialization,
   `AuthorityDirectiveV1`,
   `ApprovalAuthorityTemplateV1`, versioned `ApprovalAuthorityBindingV1`,
   bounded rebinding/readback/reissue, atomic run head initialization, the
   Rust-owned authority overlay, `EffectiveAuthorityProjectionV1`,
   `AuthoritySourceManifestV2`, `AuthoritySourceMappingPolicyV2`,
   `RuntimeConstraintPolicyV2`, V2 workflow/catalog discriminators, run-level recheck fence, the control-plane
   authority-admission service and the physically separate release-owned
   authority/store, sole candidate-lineage controller, V2 launchd MCP gateway,
   reserved cross-store/authority-only operation journals with explicit
   `anchor_pending` finalize and Keychain-anchored backup/event
   chain with complete supersession-race, CAS, idempotency, auth and per-attempt
   readback tests.
5. Import every Phase -2/Phase -1 row and exact request/result/error triplet from
   `AgentContextBootstrapOperationManifestV1` byte-identically into the first
   generated `operations.yaml` under `frozen_bootstrap_compatibility`, then
   publish the protected generated operation manifest, error registry and exact
   northbound discovery/request/result/error schemas and boundary rows. The
   import exact-set and byte comparison must pass before any production row is
   added; neither manifest may reinterpret a bootstrap operation. Implement PrincipalClass plus CallerClass/capability checks, coherent
   acyclic start selection/result and same-session MCP negotiation token,
   descriptor `outputSchema` plus real `structuredContent`/JCS mirror, replay
   ordering/scoping, attempt readback,
   generic runtime-owner absence verification, replacement-admission issuance
   and atomic forward candidate replacement, per-command semantic intent fields, canonical replay, phase
   nullability, authority readback watermarks, the closed retry matrix, and shared MCP/GraphQL/report/Steward/Swift vectors
   before exposing mutations.
6. Pin the exact Agent Skills commit/corpus and tokenizer budget policy;
   generate the complete planned legacy-fragment migration manifest; move evals
   outside bundles; add immutable Git tree admission, content-addressed
   publication, ordered composition, proxy-XPC admission/activation with no
   provider-held broker endpoint, exact resource/script/Git-evidence wire including
   committed base-to-HEAD truth, tokenless ACP stdio broker projection and
   attempt-independent write-effect identity with separate read-only retry;
   publish the sole `SkillRegistryV1` from signed protected-source objects via
   the Operator maintenance command, complete all-pairs disposition set,
   neighbor graph, executable proof for every neighbor/non-neighbor pair and
   pinned trigger harness; add immutable APFS-snapshot Git capture, the outer
   provider Seatbelt profile, complete proxy launch closure and signed opaque

   adapter plus the inner script
   runner, startup/escape attestations, script/apply journals and recovery. Keep

7. Rewrite every production role, `skill_role`, prompt, inline/builtin skill,

8. Add `RunContextGenerationBindingV2`, daemon self-admission,

   prompt fencing, and every
   pre/post-install crash-recovery test.
9. Replace prompt assembly with `PromptEnvelopeV2`, enforce full provider-

   atomic latest-head projection intents, fenced worker leases,

   add signed versioned-row keyset cursors, startup reconciliation, singleton

10. Add the protected holdout vault, observed/pairwise-sibling-shadow/adversarial

   isolated typed reviewer fan-out and per-evaluation-arm isolation/cleanup,
   release-owned
   `EvaluationTrustPolicyV1`, complete candidate manifest, signed worker-lease
   evidence admission with anti-self-certification, sole candidate-lineage
   controller and table-scoped evaluation controller, fixed-point evaluator, exact
   trigger policy, protected-base required CI selector/gate manifest/driver plus
   signed execution and branch-protection receipts, native dependency/FFI
   inventory plus keyless build/probe observation journals and distinct
   purpose-isolated confinement/ABI attestors, restart-safe SQLite alert
   snapshots, candidate/probe state stores, complete proof matrix, app
   qualification harness and MCP run-start negotiation.
11. Run the complete five-repetition baseline/candidate live evaluation and
   retain a passing `AgentQualityPromotionReceiptV1` for the exact production
   candidate manifest.
12. Stop the bridge daemon, transfer the launchd loopback MCP descriptor to the
    release-authority gateway, acquire the fenced migration lease, keep the
    candidate daemon stopped, obtain the external runtime-attestor receipt for
    the final candidate binary, build and verify the complete go/no-go inventory and every external-effect
    classification/settlement action, then atomically advance
    `not_started / legacy_bridge -> schema_prepared / closed_v2_pending`; verify
    `admission_closed` before binding mutation surfaces or workers.
13. Drain active provider/effect truth, persist `legacy_settled`, execute the
    all-or-nothing `legacy_execution_sealed` settlement, and prove zero legacy
    producer row remains claimable.
14. Verify runtime self-admission, execute promotion to `probe_v2`, consume one
    complete provider/effect/app proof-matrix epoch, classify its aggregate
    receipt, and execute open only after every cell passes.
    Infrastructure-inconclusive or process-clearance proof uses the atomic
    same-generation reprobe command.
15. Read back `open_v2`, migration lease/head/repair state, projection heads,
    generation, proof/self-admission receipts, current app and MCP-profile
    qualification rows and a same-session MCP run-start negotiation token
    before allowing an ordinary start.
16. Prove mixed-version errors, complete northbound auth/idempotency vectors,
    generation-CAS, migration lease takeover/fencing, bounded blocked repair and
    explicit candidate replacement without phase rollback, emergency hold, and
    context-absent live-execution denial matrices.
17. Prove deterministic release-evidence expiry, predecessor-CAS rollout-policy
    activation with unresolved-incident continuity/successor/retired-hold
    migration, key-epoch live revocation fencing, action-specific incident
    repair fault recovery and one journaled root-approved N-to-N+1 release-
    authority upgrade. Retain the explicit
    unsupported cross-device host-loss result.
18. Run a small roadmap proposal end to end and let Steward perform the first
    post-run analysis.

There is no mixed production execution period or selectable flag. While the
migration head is `not_started`, the bridge release supports V2 read/eval
infrastructure but admits only the existing context-absent execution path. Once
`schema_prepared` commits, no new context-absent start is possible; once
`legacy_execution_sealed` commits, no context-absent continuation is possible.
Ordinary production run creation remains closed until `open_v2`; afterward
every new run binds the exact open V2 generation and the database has no
context-absent write path. Existing legacy snapshots remain immutable readback
records only.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Every newly compiled production invocation contains
   `agent_context_envelope_v2`, a valid immutable `RunMissionV1` base, pinned
   `EffectiveRunMissionV1`, `EffectiveAuthorityProjectionV1`,
   `AuthoritySourceManifestV2`, `AuthoritySourceMappingPolicyV2`,
   `RuntimeConstraintPolicyV2`, `workflow_v2` and `agent_catalog_v2` identities,
   authority-fence digest,
   `AgentExecutionAttemptV1`, `AgentRoleV1`, `TaskAssignmentV1`, ordered
   `SkillCompositionV1`, `PromptEnvelopeV2`, and a durable generation binding.
2. Every production agent has an explicit role charter and no production agent
   uses `inline_skill`, `builtin_agent`, `skill_role`, an arbitrary catalog
   prompt, `roles/*.md` role authority, or a hardcoded role map.
3. Rust and Swift reconstruct identical genesis, ordered base ledger, empty-base
   head, base events and overlay chain. `runs.start` prepares the immutable
   genesis/head in the authority store, commits only an unclaimable provisional
   Run/projection in control-plane SQLite, and cannot return or admit work until

     and no journal or mutation-projection receipt. V1 GraphQL/MCP and V2 share
     pre-resource/replay partition admission and wrong-family requests are
     non-enumerating zero-write.
109. Automatic Steward `config_change` ownership binds the actual pending
     previous/current config/catalog hashes, work-item/enqueue and daemon
     observation and never fabricates `steward.run_analysis` or a command
     journal. Command-triggered config changes remain a separate origin arm.
110. Steward migration maps zero calls to no `AgentExecution`, one call to a
     `system_steward` generation-one child, and two calls to distinct
     `system_steward` and conditional `steward_auditor` generation-one children
     linked by the signed health report; it never models them as retries.
111. `ProviderPromptSeriesV2` is immutable identity only. Every ordinal,
     counter and reservation head advances through a predecessor-linked
     `ProviderPromptSeriesStateV2` CAS; attempt settlement and all readbacks bind
     the terminal state digest/revision.
112. The additive GraphQL excerpt extends approved-HEAD `QueryRoot` and
     `MutationRoot` and does not redeclare legacy approval payloads/unions.
     Generated SDL exact-set checks reject wrong root names and any duplicate
     root field or legacy type.
113. Every northbound command computes `CanonicalCommandOutcomeCoreV1` after
     preallocating its resource ID/binding but before either writer. For
     `runs.start`, the authority operation core and run admission reference that
     core, never vice versa; commit/finalize fixtures reject every reverse edge.
114. All six mandatory preflight cases materialize complete run-report, MCP,
     release-receipt and GraphQL readbacks. Nested legacy producer bytes remain
     evidence, while the signed mandatory-policy adapter exposes only
     `repair_rollout_contract` and no waiver/disable/permissive/bypass action.
115. Prompt-turn aggregate budget is independently configured and no greater
     than the checked per-purpose sum, making aggregate-only exhaustion
     reachable. Repository object cap is 8388608 bytes, so exact-resource and
     one-byte-overflow fixtures exercise both resource and discovery policies.
116. The handoff migration's sole 2000 ms durable deadline starts before its
     first direct probe and is checked before/after every probe, scan and
     payload stage. Exact and plus-one vectors at each stage cannot reset the
     clock or perform a migration write after expiry.
117. Ruleset exact-preimage restore is allowed only before any candidate or
     release-evidence issuance/selection adopts the staged postimage. After
     candidate/release-evidence adoption or authority migration, every sidecar,
     lane and fixture requires forward repair and forbids automatic removal,
     disable or waiver.

## Implementation Boundary

This document specifies the revised architecture but does not approve code
changes while proposal-readiness re-review is pending. After a ready verdict,
the next artifact is a file-by-file implementation plan with tests ordered
before production migration. Implementation must preserve unrelated dirty work
and must not begin until that plan has been reviewed.
